scoring_justification: Full DFT recomputation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring compares submitted scalars to paper-reported references with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for EOS parameters and metallization pressure from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Phys. Rev. B 75, 054507): theoretical EOS fit parameters V0=46.04(5) Å³, B0=123(2) GPa, B'=3.43(9); metallization pressure 324 GPa.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported by the authors, guaranteeing the checker rewards a correct reproduction consistent with the original work.

outputs.description: Fitted parameters of the Birch-Murnaghan equation of state for LiBC under GGA-PBE.
Pressure at which LiBC becomes (semi)metallic according to GGA-PBE.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares these values to paper-reported references with tolerances that absorb legitimate code/pseudopotential differences. The qualitative bonding analysis (projected density of states, electron density maps) is not scored as it yields no quantifiable target.
